decisions.reason: The supplied default configuration enables MBEDTLS_PK_PARSE_C. The old entry therefore compiles its five-argument call against a seven-argument declaration, preventing the target from building.
decisions.finite_witness: Invoke the supplied build recipe with the default config and any fuzz input, including empty bytes. Compilation reaches the guarded call and rejects its argument count before execution.

scope_contract.reason: In-memory private-key parsing is the entry’s primary operation; the changed declaration requires an RNG callback and context.

feasible_trigger.reason: The recipe uses source defaults, which define MBEDTLS_PK_PARSE_C; the guard therefore includes the stale call in the target build.

evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe only sets a time option before building programs/fuzz.

observable_consequence.reason: C compilation rejects five arguments for the seven-argument declared function, so this target cannot produce a working artifact through the supplied route.

evidence.dependency_reason: Enables compilation of the guarded call.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete old entry has no alternative parser call. Both recipe build attempts use the same tree; the after-source copy also retains the five-argument call.

evidence.dependency_reason: The fallback does not alter source.

identity_preserved.reason: The contract, enabled guard, mismatched call and build consequence all concern the same mbedtls_pk_parse_key invocation.

evidence.dependency_reason: Establishes that the guard is active.

scope.summary: The default config resolves the earlier uncertainty: the old target has an established build blocker. The supplied scope is not sufficient because this blocker prevents execution; remaining change groups do not negate it.
